verdict.rationale: Self-hosting under an open-source license is a fair question for a design and website-builder platform, since open-source, self-hostable design tools exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Framer can be self-hosted or is open-source licensed. It is presented as a hosted AI website builder with staging and publishing on framer.app and custom domains. Static file hosting on Framer-hosted sites is not self-hosting the platform.
